title: Mixed Event — Run! Sports Festival! Committee Rush

meta.Outline: Saki invites Haruka to join the Sports Festival Planning Committee. Together with fellow committee member Emu, they strive to make the Sports Festival a fun and joyful event, but how will it turn out?

rows.Line: Lunch Break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (It's lunch time already? I should double check what we're doing for practice after school tomorrow.)

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Huh? What's this penguin eraser doing on the floor?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Hey, that looks like one of the new Phenny products they just released. It's so cute.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, that's mine.
I must have dropped it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks for picking it up.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Oh, uh. Sure...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Wow, I just talked to Haruka Kiritani!
Idols really do have an aura, don't they?!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Lucky... I want to talk to her too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I've been back at school for a while now, but I guess I still don't quite fit it.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I wish I could talk to others like everyone else...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haruka, are you busy right now?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We were wondering if you'd like to have lunch with us.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Tenma, Hoshino...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I guess some girls are fine talking to me, so maybe I shouldn't worry about this too much.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, are you working on a practice schedule? It's okay if you're busy....

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
No, I can join you.
I was just double-checking, so let's go have lunch.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Great! Let's go, let's go!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ichi, did you buy yakisoba buns again?
You really love those things, don't you?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I think you ate the same thing the first time we had lunch together.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah... They're just so good.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I guess it is pretty hard to get bored of something you really like.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh hey, the Sports Festival is coming up pretty soon. Have you two decided which events you're gonna be in?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Not yet.
But I'd like to do something that doesn't involve any running...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The Sports Festival...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I became so busy after becoming an idol that I rarely had time to go to classes.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But now, I have time to participate in school events. This is wonderful...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I wonder which events Minori and the others are doing. I'll ask them tomorrow during practice.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What about you, Haruka?
Any idea which events you want to be in?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, I'm not sure either.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: To be honest, work kept me away from school for so long that I'm not even sure what events there are to choose from.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I think the last time I participated in a school event was back when I was in fifth grade...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I didn't mean to ruin the mood.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, you didn't!
I found something we have in common!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I was in the hospital during most of middle school, so it's been a long time since I got to be in an event like this too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right.
I forgot you were out of school too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yep! But I was even able to join a sports team, so it's all good now!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I've never been able to participate in a Sports Festival before, so I'm really excited! I just can't decide which events I want to be in.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We'll probably end up having to do rock-paper-scissors or a raffle to choose who gets to be in the really popular events! I can't wait!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to it as well.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki, aren't you part of the planning committee for the Sports Festival?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yep! We have our first meeting after school today.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But there aren't very many people on the committee this year, apparently. I'm a little disappointed.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Really? That's kind of surprising. It sounds fun, so I figured there would be quite a few people interested in joining.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A lot of students here are fairly dedicated when it comes to their studies or club activities. I think that may be part of the reason why so few of them get excited about school events.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Our school has the credit-based course too, so there are a lot of students doing things outside of school as well, like you used to.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I suppose that's true....

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm the only one in my class who's on the committee. I wish someone else to join me too though...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I tried asking around, but everyone turned me down. Even Ichi is busy as a class representative...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If only there were someone else I could ask...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, I know!
Haruka, why don't you join me?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What? Me?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Saki, Kiritani just formed a new idol group.
I doubt she has time for anything like that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Well, I have some time. But I'm not sure I'll be in attendance every time the committee meets though.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's totally fine!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Even though it's a planning committee, I heard that there isn't a lot of work involved.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: All we really have to do is go to a few meetings, act as referees and help set up some stuff for the event.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It shouldn't be too much for you, Haruka. I'd love to have you help us out!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(I've never done anything like this before.
Maybe it'll be a good opportunity.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: In that case, let me ask the other girls in my group to make sure they're okay with me doing this. Can you give me a few minutes?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(Well, I sent them a message....
But I wonder if they'll be okay with it.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(Oh, someone replied.
It's from... Airi?)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <The planning committee for the Sports Festival? That sounds fun!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <You sound worried about it affecting practice, but you'll only be doing work up through the Sports Festival, right?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <This isn't something you'll be able to do once we get back to being real idols! So you should enjoy stuff like this while you can!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, it looks like Minori and Shizuku said it's okay too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Thanks, everyone...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Tenma, I can help out with the planning committee.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You mean it?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. Everyone in the group said that they're okay with it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Awesome! Thanks, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
That's great, Saki.
Thanks, Kiritani. We know you're busy so...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We're meeting after school today for the first time, so let's go together! You'll get to meet everyone on the team!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, got it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm so excited...! Wonderhoy!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The Sports Festival is coming! I'm so excited, I feel like I can make a song for it right now!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Sports Festival, it's been a while〜♪
Let's all run with a really big smile~♪

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line:
Wh-What's with her...?
Why is she singing to herself?

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line:
That's Otori from 1-B.
She's always like that.

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line:
Oh, really?
She's really strange...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Which events should I join, I dunno〜♪
Cavalry, relays, what a show〜♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe! I can't wait...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's gonna be so much fun after school!
After School
Sports Festival Planning Committee - First Meeting

rows.Speaker: Committee Member A
rows.Line: It sounds like we're in agreement. We'll stick to the same events as usual from previous years.

rows.Speaker: Committee Member B
rows.Line: As for setting up the day of, that will be the same way as well. Duties will be divided up between committee members and...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (This is very different from what I expected.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I always imagined Sports Festivals as everyone working together to come up with fun ideas.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(But nobody is really voicing any opinions.
They all seem somewhat dispassionate.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I guess Hoshino did mention that not many of the students here get particularly excited about school events, so this is probably normal.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haruka, I'm sorry...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You were nice enough to join the committee with me, but this probably isn't what you were expecting, huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's okay, Tenma. This is a prep school after all, so everyone is probably focused more on their studies than school events.

rows.Speaker: Committee Member A
rows.Line: Alright, that should do it for today's initial meeting.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Not so fast!!

rows.Speaker: Committee Member B
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hm? What's going on?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I believe that's Emu Otori from 1-B.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I want to organize a more exciting sports festival!

rows.Speaker: Committee Member A
rows.Line: Wh-What do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: All you've been saying this whole time is stuff from previous years...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I really don't think that's gonna make for an interesting event!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm guessing there are a lot of girls here who aren't very athletic and don't even like the Sports Festival...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I wanna come up with something that even they remember as being super fun and stuff!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: A Sports Festival where everyone smiles, or in other words...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I want this Sports Festival to be the best show anyone's ever seen!!

rows.Speaker: Committee Member A
rows.Line: Sh-Show...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: She reminds me a lot of my brother.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And the more fun everyone has during the event, the more energized they'll be for school after that!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm here to give everyone hope for a better tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So I think we should all come up with some fun events, decorate the place together and...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's all brainstorm ways to make this Sports Festival super fun!

rows.Speaker: Committee Member A
rows.Line: Yeah, but the committee this year is so small. Even if we do come up with new ideas, there's no telling if we'll even have enough time to get ready.

rows.Speaker: Committee Member B
rows.Line: That's right. We also have to keep in mind that we have exams coming up right after too...

rows.Speaker: Committee Member B
rows.Line: We're all taking time away from our studies to do this. Asking everyone to invest even more time might be going a little too far.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But... But...! If we all work together, I'm sure we'll find a way...

rows.Speaker: Committee Member A
rows.Line: I appreciate your suggestions, Emu, but I just don't think it's very feasible.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But... I...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree with Otori. I'm for her idea.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! Haruka?!

rows.Speaker: Committee Member A
rows.Line: You're...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I'm Haruka Kiritani.
I understand your concerns. However...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This is an event where everyone at school is supposed to participate, so I think we should make it enjoyable for as many people as possible.

rows.Speaker: Committee Member A
rows.Line: That still doesn't change the fact that we just don't have the manpower to handle a bunch of new events.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: In that case, how about we revive some of the older events instead?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: There's a guidebook in the library that details everything about this school's past Sports Festivals. I went through it earlier today and saw a few that might be fun.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Since they were held in the past, all the necessary equipment should still be here and setup shouldn't be a problem.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The current format also splits each event up by grade, but what if we had all grades competing together?

rows.Speaker: Committee Members
rows.Line: Wouldn't that be a little difficult?

rows.Speaker: Committee Members
rows.Line: Yeah, that sounds like a lot of extra work...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If students can choose when to practice ahead of time, we can have all grades practice together and it shouldn't take too much time out of their schedules.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: These changes should be manageable even with a small committee like this or not a lot of time to practice to go around.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wooow...! Those are awesome ideas!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, that sounds fun!

rows.Speaker: Committee Member A
rows.Line: We might actually be able to pull off something like this...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Committee Member B
rows.Line: But we'll have to decide which events to bring back and come up with a practice schedule for all of the students...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That won't be a problem. Otori and I made these suggestions, so we will come up with a few proposals before the next meeting.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Does that work for you?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! I'm the one who started it, so of course I'll see it through to the end!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'll help out as well! I want to make this a fun Sports Festival for everyone too.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thanks!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's make this a Sports Festival that everyone will remember!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! Wonderhoy☆

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wonderhoy...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hahaha! That's so adorable! You're just too much, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. I agree.
She may be a little strange, but...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, hey! Since we're making changes, why not make the opening ceremony a big show too?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We could have clouds of smoke everywhere for a giant robot to fly out of, and have it zoom around the track and stuff!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Okay...
Make that very strange...
A few days later
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Campus

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Welcome to the gymnasium's storeroom!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I just hope we can find everything we need for each event.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I didn't realize there was a separate storeroom on campus for the gym. I thought the one inside there was the only one.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, this is your first time out here then, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. Did you know about this storeroom?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yep! I found it when I went exploring after the entrance ceremony!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I tried to get inside but it was locked, so I had to climb up and look through the window.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Wait, the window...?
You don't mean the one on the roof, do you?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! But I got into trouble after one of the teachers saw me up there...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So this is the first time I've actually been inside!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (She says that so nonchalantly but that window is about as high as a two-story house.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hey, it's open!
Haruka, let's go inside!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sure. It's dark, so please watch your step...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nooo waaay!!!!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wh-What happened?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Look, Haruka! Bamboo poles! This means we can do the bamboo tug-of-war event!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Is that all? You scared me there...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I don't think I've ever seen anyone get so excited over bamboo poles before.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hm? What do you think this is?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They might be old class flags. It looks like someone spent a lot of time on them too.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
You're right!
They've got some really cool designs!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It'd be fun to use in some sort of show! We could hoist them during the climax and...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: A show?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You mentioned a show during the meeting too. Do you enjoy seeing shows and performances?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, I forgot to tell you...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm a cast member for the Show Stage at Phoenix Wonderland!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We work hard every day to put smiles on the faces of everyone who comes to visit♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Smiles on everyone's faces...?
That's a wonderful goal.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! We're always trying to come up with super fun shows! You should come see one sometime, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe, I imagine any show with you in it would be fun. I'll have to make time to visit.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really?! Awesome!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh wait! We're here to find things for the Sports Festival! Let's keep looking, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sure. I hope we're able to find what we need for the more interesting events.
A few days later

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Um, excuse me! I made a sample announcement flyer for Sports Festival. Could you take a look?

rows.Speaker: Committee Member A
rows.Line:
Let's see...
Breaking away from last year's program, this year's Sports Festival will feature events that all students can enjoy together.

rows.Speaker: Committee Member A
rows.Line: Have you come up with a list of which events you'd like us to do?

rows.Speaker: Committee Member A
rows.Line: We'll need to make lists for which students will be competing in each event as well.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Um, well...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Here ya go!
A list of events hot off the press!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: E-Emu?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe! Haruka and I dug through the storeroom the other day and found all sorts of stuff we can to use♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We're looking over old guidebooks to arrange an event schedule too!

rows.Speaker: Committee Member A
rows.Line: Arrange...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yep! We want to make sure there are events that even the busier students can participate in without needing to practice much!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm actually on my way to meet her and work on it right now.

rows.Speaker: Committee Member A
rows.Line: What? But it'll be dark soon. Isn't it a bit late today?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I thought I noticed Haruka staying late the past few days. Is that because you two have been working on the event schedule?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: Committee Member A
rows.Line: I didn't realize...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe! We're gonna bring you a list of events to the next meeting that'll definitely put smiles on everyone's faces! See you then♪
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Classroom

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Phew... That's the last of them.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Great!
These all look super fun☆

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (We managed to finish the event schedule, but now we need to come up with participant lists.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (We need one for each event that combines all the grade levels too. This might get a little complicated...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But we suggested it, so we have to take responsibility and get it done somehow...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: This event's definitely gonna make all the less athletic girls every grade smile! Don't you think so, Haruka?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Yeah, I think so too.
Let's keep at it.
The next day

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Here, Haruka!
This is a list of participants.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh...? Did you put this together, Tenma?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: For every event... This must have been a lot of work.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, I didn't do this all by myself.
The other committee members helped too!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Wait, really?
I thought they were all too busy...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I think seeing you and Emu work so hard motivated them to help out a little more.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: They all even said that they want to see everyone enjoying the Sports Festival too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I have a feeling this year's Sports Festival is gonna be a really good one!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see. That's wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Haruka, look! The balls for the ball toss turned out super cute♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wow! Pink and blue ones too!
They really are cute!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe! This'll make things even more fun♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I completely forgot...! I have practice for the three-legged race today!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We're supposed to be teaming up with girls from the higher grades this year, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. I thought it'd be nice for younger students to mingle with the older ones since they usually don't get the chance to...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Gotta go! See you later!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Okay.
Good luck at practice.
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Campus

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's see... Practice for the three-legged race is supposed to be here...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And what was the name of the girl I'm partnered with again?
Are you Otori?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hwah?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yes, ma'am! I'm Emu Otori!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hm? Have we met before somewhere...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hello. I'm Mafuyu Asahina from 2-B.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't get the chance to speak with many first years outside of club activities. It's nice to meet you, Otori.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's nice to meet you too!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Friend A
rows.Line: Hey, Mafuyu! Good luck in the three-legged race!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Friend B
rows.Line: We'll be cheering for you!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, that's embarrassing...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow! You're so popular!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's nothing like that. But it is nice to have them cheering me on.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Friend A
rows.Line: Mafuyu's amazing! Not only is she super smart and great at school, she's really athletic. She's in the big relay race too, right?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Friend B
rows.Line: Yeah, she's perfect at everything!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thanks. Otori and I will do our best.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hwah!?!?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hm? Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: N-N-No, it's n-n-nothing!!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Are you sure? If there's something on your mind, don't hesitate to ask.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hwah!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Wh-What is this?! She's smiling but it doesn't feel like she's smiling...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Sh-She's really scary...!!!!)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Shall we get started, then? First we tie our shoes together with a figure-8 knot and...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (That looks like Emu with... Ms. Asahina? The second year?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, Emu, you and Ms. Asahina are partners for the three-legged race. Good luck!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: H-Honami...!

rows.Line: Hey, Haruka. Do you have any plans after this?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We were talking about having a party to celebrate. If you're not busy, would you like to come?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We'll just be going to the diner down the street, but anyone who can join us is invited.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You don't mind if I join...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Of course you can come!
You were named the MVP of 1-C after all!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The MVP?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You didn't just decide that yourself right now, did you?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe. Busted.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thanks, you two.
I don't have any plans, so I'd love to go.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Great! I wonder what I should get...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We'll head back to the classroom and wait for you there.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (That's right. I guess today is over...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Haruka, we finished cleaning up our part!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay. The only thing left for the planning committee to do is to finish locking up.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's kind of sad...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What is?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I really enjoyed today, but...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm sad that it's over.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I wish we could put on a Sports Festival tomorrow, and the next day, and the day after that... Everyday!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
It is sad...
Why can't we have fun all the time?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You think so too?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah.
But my grandpa taught me something...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: He said that fun is the thing that lets us look forward to tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: To look forward to tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Our fun for today is over...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I'll just have to do another show tomorrow and put those smiles back on everyone's faces!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You remind me a lot of someone.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, it's nothing.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I guess I can't stay sad myself either.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I still need to spread more hope for tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Emu, our stages may be different, but let's both continue doing what we can.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's do our best tomorrow too!!
A few days later
Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I have to meet with Airi and the others so we can start making our schedule and...)

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: Um, Kiritani? Do you have a minute?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, sure. What is it?

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: I wanted to give you this to say thank you for running in my place the other day.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wait... Is this a limited edition Phenny keychain?!

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: Yeah. I noticed you had a Phenny eraser, so I thought you might like it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you! I was too busy with work when this was on sale, so I wasn't able to get one!

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: I'm glad you like it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you so much. I'll take good care of it.

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: Um... I was also wondering...

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: Would you like to hang out after school some time?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sure, I'd love to.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka! You're heading up to the roof, right? Let's go together!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, Minori. Okay, I'll be right there.

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: I'll let you go! See you tomorrow, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: See you tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka, you seem happier than usual today!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. You think so?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I have to take all the smiles everyone gives me and pay it forward...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, it's nothing.
Let's go, Minori!
